description: This Java source file defines the ChangeLogVersionFinder class, which provides methods to retrieve and manage Liquibase snapshot and update change logs, including version filtering, filename generation, and version comparison.

classes.name: ChangeLogVersionFinder
classes.description: A class to find and manage different versions of Liquibase change logs, including snapshots and updates, with methods for retrieving filenames, latest versions, and version comparisons.

methods.name: ChangeLogVersionFinder
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the change log version provider.

methods.name: ChangeLogVersionFinder
methods.description: Constructor allowing to inject a custom provider (for testing purposes).

methods.name: getChangeLogCombinations
methods.description: Returns a sorted map of snapshot versions mapped to their associated change log filenames and update files.

methods.name: getSnapshotCombinations
methods.description: Returns a sorted map of snapshot versions mapped only to their filenames.

methods.name: getSnapshotFilenames
methods.description: Generates filenames for schema-only and core data snapshots for a given version.

methods.name: getLatestSnapshotVersion
methods.description: Returns the latest snapshot version as an optional value.

methods.name: getLatestSchemaSnapshotFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the latest schema-only snapshot.

methods.name: getLatestCoreDataSnapshotFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the latest core data snapshot.

methods.name: getUpdateVersionsGreaterThan
methods.description: Filters and returns update versions that are greater than a specified version.

methods.name: getUpdateFileNames
methods.description: Generates filenames for provided list of update versions.

methods.name: getSnapshotVersions
methods.description: Retrieves all snapshot versions from the provider.

methods.name: getUpdateVersions
methods.description: Retrieves all update versions from the provider.

methods.name: getVersionAsDotX
methods.description: Extracts major.minor part of a version string, appended with a 'x'. Throws IllegalArgumentException if pattern does not match.
